description: Mundo's CATALOGUE of 3D pieces (neblla.world, the mundo chapter of the guide): low-poly models in one style, CC0 (Kenney's Platformer Kit, licence checked 2026-10-21), in metres (1 unit = 1 m, the base at y = 0, a door is 2 m, the standard doll 1.83 m). Pieces are loaded in client.js with `const m = await world.load('catalog:<id>')` and `world.add({ model: m, position })` or `world.scatter(m, [...])`. Actions: "search" { query, kind?, limit? (10, max 50), lang? ("es" | "en": which name is the title) } → { pieces: [{ id, title, name: { es, en }, kind, tags, size: [x, y, z] metres, triangles, license, author, url, load, animations? }] }, best first; a query in Spanish or English, plural or not ("plataforma de lava", "pine tree", "monedas"); the catalogue has no lava: search lists only the pieces it has. "get" { id } → { piece }; "list" { kind?, offset?, limit? } → { pieces, total }; "doll" → the standard doll: its bones (fixed names), the measures of a body and their ranges (world.doll({ height, width, legs, torso, arms, head }), 1 = standard), the test bodies and the moves (doll.play(name)). "check_obby" { obby } → { ok, errors, warnings }: checks an obby JSON before it goes into world.obby(json) (see the mundo chapter of the guide): every error at once, each { path (pieces[3].move.by), code, message } saying what to write instead; fix them all and check again. Kinds: terrain, platform, hazard, pickup, mechanism, nature, prop. Errors: world_bad_kind, world_unknown_piece.

kind.description: For search and list: only this kind

obby.description: For check_obby: the obby JSON (an object, or its text)

query.description: For search: what the piece is, in any words: "plataforma", "árboles de nieve", "spike trap"
